learningObjectives: Compare stored-water policies and protect continuity without inventing supplies

proposal.purpose: The household has exhausted its 1 gallon of stored water. The simulation advances to reflect the depletion of this resource. With the well pump unavailable and no stored water remaining, the household now faces an unmet water requirement. The next decision should focus on identifying alternative water sources or emergency supply procurement.
